cites.quote: Docket No. EO26080463
This RFI is issued pursuant to the signing of P.L. 2026, c.32, also known as the Data Center Fair Share Act, into Law.
P.L. 2026, CHAPTER 32, approved July 7, 2026
This act shall take effect immediately.

No later than 12 months after the effective date of this section, the Board of Public Utilities shall establish, by order for every electric public utility, standards for the provision of electricity to large data center customers by electric public utilities.
No later than 180 days after the board issues an order establishing standards for the provision of electricity to large data center customers
The deadline for responses on this matter is 5 p.m. on November 13, 2026.

rows.notes: A statewide rule binding each New Jersey electric public utility's future large data center tariff (the Maryland and Pennsylvania model rows are alike). The enacted text is Section 1 as numbered 31 in the Fourth Reprint; the bracketed, deleted Section 1 of earlier reprints (100 MW, 85 percent for not less than 10 years) is not the law and is not quoted. Existing service: a large data center approved by a utility before the act's effective date is exempt from paragraphs (1), (2) and (8) of subsection d (the 85 percent guarantee, the security, the study costs) for the approved megawatts only (Section 1g). Other required tariff terms: demand flexibility commitments, priority curtailment before residential customers in system emergencies, disclosure of similar requests pending at other utilities (Section 1b(11) and (12), 1d(5)). BPU stakeholder meeting held 4 November 2026 (the slides). Queue: PSE&G's pipeline is on its own row; no Jersey Central Power & Light, Atlantic City Electric or Rockland Electric pipeline was found in the documents read (FirstEnergy's site terms bar reuse, siting-gaps; Exelon's terms bar automated access, pjm_east group; neither read).
